title: Left move away from the boundary
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $p$ be a position in the range of $n+2$ positions with $p\ne0$. Moving $p$ by $-1$ with clamping gives the position $p-1$.
hypotheses_covered: A position p in the range of n + 2 positions
replaced:
Let $p$ be an input-head position on an input of length $n$ with $p \ne 0$. Then the
clamped move of $p$ by the sign $-1$ is exactly the position $p - 1$: a left move that
does not start at the left boundary decrements the position.
